xmldoc.short_description: Collapse the nodes of a tree.

param_input_item.param_description: a tree object (created by uitree) or a tree node object (created by uitreenode).
also collapses every descendant node (case-insensitive, may be abbreviated).

description.p: collapse(t) collapses the top-level nodes of the tree t. When t is a tree node, only that node is collapsed.
collapse(t, 'all') collapses t and every node below it, at every level.
Without 'all', the descendants keep their state: they are shown again as they were when their parent is expanded.
Calling collapse does not run the NodeCollapsedFcn callback of the tree.
A first input that is not a tree or a tree node raises the error Nelson:uicomponent:expectedTree.
